text: 🎬 Affleck's Batman would have buried Jim Gordon Joe Manganiello , who played Deathstroke, says the canceled Ben Affleck Batman movie would have killed Commissioner Gordon. It's a single interview anecdote, so treat it as color and not as a confirmed plot. Still, the choice fits. Gordon is Batman's last link to a Gotham that trusts anyone, and killing him would have pushed this older, battered Bruce toward the bleak endgame that 'Justice League' only hinted at. It's a bold swing, and DC never got to show it. Manganiello's Deathstroke was last seen in a post-credits scene.

🎬 'Animals' is now Netflix's biggest streaming hit Ben Affleck directs and co-stars in an R-rated, 108-minute thriller that, per /Film, has topped Netflix's streaming numbers. It's a lean, adult genre piece, with no franchise and no multiverse. Kerry Washington follows 'Wake Up Dead Man' with another Netflix win. Two hits in a row make her one of the platform's most dependable faces. Affleck as director-for-hire, delivering tight thrillers at a streamer's pace, suits him better than another capes-and-cowls detour. Mid-budget grown-up movies didn't die.
